Class CannotMoveCommand

java.lang.Object
model.player.command.cannotmove.CannotMoveCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command, MoveCommand
Direct Known Subclasses:
BlockRollTooSmallCommand, ExactRollRequiredCommand, MoveBlockedByBlockadeCommand, SickRollTooSmallCommand
public abstract class CannotMoveCommand extends Object implements MoveCommand
Base class of the commands that only announce why a piece or a block cannot move. They change nothing on the board.
